name: Pedrosa del Príncipe (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of red, white and blue in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pedrosa del Príncipe (a castle on red and a column with ears of wheat on blue).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 6 February 2004 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 50 of 5 April 2004); the flag is square, of three horizontal stripes, red of 2/10, silver of 6/10 and blue of 2/10, with the municipal arms at its heart.

features.role: Pedrosa del Príncipe arms — castle and column with ears of wheat
